Same spirit as general post-market autopsy, but the object is ONE sector ETF and its
environment — not SPX.

INPUTS (injected):
1. Morning sector prediction for this sector
2. Channel 1: actual sector ETF open/close/% change; SPY % change; relative return
3. Archived morning ETF context

1. What drove the sector today (taxonomy-aligned factors preferred)
2. Audit morning S0–S4 reads against reality (use morning numbers, not post-close
   rewrites of the morning)

4. Outliers inside the sector

**2. Spine — one AI-infra cluster, not three hits.** NVDA AHR 08-26 is **market-confirmed** (Thu NVDA ~+8.7%, XLK +3.16%, IT the only S&P sector up). That is the live fundamental spine: data-center $89B, Q3 ~$108B, FY28 ~70% supply-constrained, demand > guided supply. Hyperscaler 2026 capex still ~$710B+, TSMC leading-edge ~full, HBM 2026 allocated / CoWoS tight — **structural, already in the 1m +7.5% rel tape**. Do **not** count capex + foundry + HBM as three spines. TrendForce 08-28 VIS Fab 3 fire is 8-inch tightness, not an XLK impulse. Cloud acceleration is the same NVDA/hyperscaler cluster. **Carried, not a same-session raise.** Net spine for *today*: still intact, **not** a peak-spend kill.

**3. Secondary.** Software net-retention/large-deal: CRM ~+22%, CRWD record Q2 / +11%, ADBE ~+6% on 08-27 — **HIT, also Thursday-traded**; helpful for MSFT/ADBE sleeve, cannot carry XLK alone. ADI upgrade / Powell DC backlog = confirmation of the same AI-infra sleeve (News Judge #7), not a second macro positive. Export controls: H200 dribbles, NVDA still guides **$0 China DC** — overhang, **not** a fresh tightening print this morning. Crowded long still BofA FMS **#1 at 53%** (down from 82%) — dampener, not a washout-buy. Rotation **into** technology was Thursday’s fact; it is not a fresh Friday bid.

**4. Breadth / leadership.** Thursday was **large-cap + high-beta AI hardware** (NVDA) with software sympathy. Mega-cap **is** the XLK thesis — this is not “ETF up / names flat” in the fade-the-extension sense. Follow-through breadth is **unconfirmed**: Kospi −1.79%, some semi reactions to NVDA were already mixed Thu, NQ slightly red. Do not restack Thursday leadership into S2.

**5. Flows / positioning.** Public snapshots: XLK ~−$371M 1m, ~+$99M 5d — not a volume spike. Crowding + Warsh = near-term supply risk, not forced liquidation. 08-12: do not use crowding as a notable cap once a confirmed catalyst has already drawn the Thursday flow. For Friday, flows are **not** a fresh inflow spike.

**6. Earnings / policy.** NVDA and CRM/CRWD are **already public**. Warsh 10:00 ET is the load-bearing **two-sided** event. No fresh index-relevant beat this morning.

### Lessons / self-audit
- **08-12 notable:** fail (NQ not green; macro not benign; catalyst already in the tape).
- **08-13:** fires — carried AI-infra + NQ inside ±0.5% → **mild/flat cap**, multiplier ≤1.0; S4 is the same shock as S1.
- **08-27:** timestamps verified; does **not** license notable without green NQ.
- **mega-cap-over-macro-drag:** forbids **down**.
- **08-14 scheduled-data:** Warsh pending + crowded tech + provisional futures → cap **mild**, include a flat/fade path.
- **Double-count:** one AI-infra cluster in S1 only. Thursday +2.50% rel is **not** also S2 and S4.
- **Single-ticker:** NVDA is index-relevant (top XLK weight) but must not be a second-day severe/notable by itself; AMD/mixed semi tape already showed that Thu.
- **Divergence:** leading S1 still modestly positive vs live NQ/S4 non-confirm → **flag**; trust factors over tape for *direction floor* (not down), but tape vetoes magnitude.
- Open experiment: |leading sum| < 4 → keep the band **flat/mild**.

**Call shape the pipeline should not override:** absolute **flat** (mild residual), not up/notable and not down. Narrative and components agree: Σ = 1.0 × 0.9 = **0.9**.

## 0. Facts

## 1. What drove the sector

Taxonomy: **S0 policy/duration shock**, amplified by **S1 hardware leadership unwind** after a +2.50% rel day, not a broken AI-demand spine.

Warsh’s first Jackson Hole keynote as Chair (~10:00 ET) was the load-bearing print. He kept 2% PCE as a “firm, fixed target,” said summer CPI/PCE were “better than expected” but **do not show meaningful improvement in underlying trends**, and: “We must be confident that underlying inflation is moving to our objective, clearly and at sufficient speed. Otherwise, we have work to do.” Markets heard hike optionality, not Powell-style easing. 2Y **+~8 to +12 bp** (CNBC ~4.31%; later wrap 4.356%), 10Y **+5.4 bp to 4.726%**, CME Sept hike odds **~35–40% → ~55–57%**. That is a duration tax on long-duration AI hardware, not a new foundry/HBM/capex kill. Warsh even described AI infra capex as a growth impulse — the *fundamental* S1 spine was not retracted.

Hardware vs software split confirms the taxonomy: NVDA **−4.57%** to $217.55 (gave back more than half of Thursday’s ~+8.7%); SOX **−3.47%**; SOXX **−3.20%**; AMD **−2.33%**; INTC **−2.85%**. MSFT **+1.68%**, AAPL **+1.63%**, ADBE **+0.82%**, GOOGL **+1.74%**, AMZN **+3.97%**. XLK fell because it is NVDA/semi-heavy, not because “tech” as a whole was bidless.

Secondary, same-window: Chicago PMI **47.1** vs ~58 cons (9:45 ET, weakest of the year) — a growth miss in the same hour, **not** NFP/CPI-class and not the thing that repriced the 2Y. MRVL **−10.28%** after Thursday AH (beat/raise but GM guide 57.5–58.5% nGAAP and Google custom upside pushed to FY29+) — intra-semi outlier, not an XLK-weight analog of NVDA.

Lessons: **08-14 scheduled-data** (cap mild, include flat/fade) was the right instinct. **08-13 / 08-12 notable-off** correctly blocked notable-*up*. **08-27 timestamp gate** correctly refused to re-trade NVDA/PCE. **After >+1% rel day** correctly refused a fresh positive. **mega-cap-over-macro-drag** **failed as a close rule** — it is an *open* constraint only.

## 3. Interactions / double-count / knowable-at-open

**One shock, not three:** Warsh hawkish + 2Y spike + hike-odds jump = **one S0**. Do not also score “real yields rising” and “USD/duration” as extra sector hits.

**One hardware unwind, not three spines failing:** NVDA −4.6% + SOX −3.5% + XLK −1.55% = **NVDA weight + semi beta**, not capex + HBM + foundry independently dying. Morning was right not to triple-count the AI cluster; the error was leaving S1 at +1 into a known two-sided 10:00.
